_description: Real-world structured FORMS (US-gov, public domain): IRS Form 1040 (2025, U.S. Individual Income Tax Return) + IRS Form W-4 (2026, Employee's Withholding Certificate). Extends the forms category beyond forms-w9 with richer layouts (numbered lines, worksheets, tables). Source PDFs stay LOCAL; only queries+baseline ship.
_labelling_rule: ANS: a concrete fact literally in the named doc; _anchor_phrase = a verbatim substring for gold resolution; answer_must_mention = whole-token any-of slots encoding the correct fact. REF (should_refuse): a plausible question whose specific answer is absent from BOTH corpus docs -> the system must refuse.
_source_note: Source PDFs are public-domain US-government works (17 USC 105), kept LOCAL (never committed); only this query set + the baseline ship. Authored by an adversarially-verified multi-agent pass, then resolved + live-eval-validated.

_baseline_answer_text_2026_06_15.stack: Qwen3.5-4B-AWQ orchestrator (ADR-0015) + EmbeddingGemma-300M (native prompts) + bge-reranker-v2-m3 (cpu, device-pinned), co_residence_mode=manual
_baseline_answer_text_2026_06_15.purpose: First REAL-WORLD multi-form answer-eval corpus (IRS Form 1040 [2025] + Form W-4 [2026] — public-domain US-gov). Extends the forms category beyond forms-w9 with dense numbered-line / worksheet / table layouts. Multi-doc: tests form-field retrieval + cross-doc/cross-year disambiguation.
_baseline_answer_text_2026_06_15.notes: POST Increment A (form-field resolver `agents/form_fields.py`, default-ON). The corpus surfaced that FORMS ARE A SYSTEM WEAK SPOT (form-field values in dense run-on `|cell|` walls defeat the LLM gates). ROOT-CAUSED (all measured, retrieval is fine — the gold fact-chunk is always in the top-5 window): the failures are at the gates/answer (3 assess + 2 relevance + 2 verify), with two sub-causes — DENSE-FORMAT (the 4B can't pick the asked value from among adjacent distractors in a run-on cell, drafts 'not available') + TRUNCATION (2 facts sit past truncate(1800) in 2.7-3.6KB chunks). INCREMENT A fixes the deduction-bullet disambiguation deterministically (route a `• label, $value` query to the dominant label, inject a verbatim `label: value` synthetic chunk): f1040-03 (refusal->$23,625) + f1040-04 (cross-doc catch $16,100->$15,750) FIXED. Result N=2 byte-stable: answered 11->12, amr 0.909->1.0, catches 1->0, false-refusals 7->6, refusal_cf=1.0. No-regression confirmed on annual-report (dense 10-K tables) + nist (byte-identical; resolver fires on 2 f1040 chunks vault-wide). RESIDUAL (6 false-refusals): 2 TRUNCATION (f1040-06 $3-campaign, f1040-09 Cat.No.11320B -> Increment B, a gate-render truncation lift) + 4 NARRATIVE-pattern (f1040-05 born-before-1961, f1040-07 Form-8995, fw4-01 $2,200, fw4-02 $500 -> brittle per-pattern regexes). RESIDUAL = a DOCUMENTED DEFER: Increment B (gate-render truncate lift) was PROBED-then-DEFERRED 2026-06-15 (measured negative — NOT surgical: 297 table-dense chunks vault-wide, no pipe-density threshold isolates the forms from the embedder papers, so it is a broad shared-gate change needing a full re-baseline, not justified for 2 cases). The 6 residual false-refusals are recorded, not chased. Source PDFs public-domain US-gov, kept LOCAL.

On the 2025 Form 1040, before which date must a taxpayer have been born to check the age box on line 12d?
How much can a taxpayer direct to the Presidential Election Campaign fund by checking the box on the 2025 Form 1040?
queries._anchor_phrase: want $3 to go to this fund

queries.question: Which forms does line 13a of the 2025 Form 1040 use to figure the qualified business income deduction?
queries._anchor_phrase: Qualified business income deduction from Form 8995 or Form 8995-A

queries.question: On the 2025 Form 1040, from which form is the American opportunity credit (line 29) carried?
queries._anchor_phrase: American opportunity credit from Form 8863, line 8

queries.question: What is the catalog number (Cat. No.) printed at the bottom of the 2025 Form 1040?
What is the exact dollar amount of the additional child tax credit refund a taxpayer receives on the 2025 Form 1040?
queries._expected_answer: Absent: the blank form only labels the additional child tax credit line (line 28) and references Schedule 8812; it contains no filled-in dollar amount for any taxpayer. (The sibling W-4 gives a $2,200 per-qualifying-child credit figure in Step 3a, but that is the W-4 withholding calc, not a Form 1040 ACTC refund amount.)

queries.question: What is the maximum income threshold for claiming the Earned Income Credit on the 2025 Form 1040?
queries._expected_answer: Absent: the 1040 only names the Earned income credit (line 27a) and references Schedule EIC; it states no income thresholds or eligibility amounts. The sibling W-4 does not mention the EIC at all.

queries.question: What filing deadline date does the 2025 Form 1040 specify for submitting the return to the IRS?
queries._expected_answer: Absent: the 1040 states the tax-year period (Jan. 1-Dec. 31, 2025) and a 'Created 9/5/25' print date but no return filing/submission due date. The sibling W-4's only date, 'February 16, 2027', is the deadline to submit a NEW Form W-4 for an exemption claim, not a tax-return filing deadline.

queries._anchor_phrase: Multiply the number of qualifying children under age 17 by $2,200

queries.question: In Step 3(b) of the 2026 Form W-4, what amount do you multiply the number of other dependents by?
queries._anchor_phrase: Multiply the number of other dependentsby $500

queries._anchor_phrase: You will need to submit a new Form W-4 by February 16, 2027.

queries._anchor_phrase: If your total income will be $200,000 or less ($400,000 or less if married filing jointly)
queries._expected_answer: $200,000 or less ($400,000 or less if married filing jointly)

queries.question: What standard deduction amounts does line 11 of the 2026 Form W-4 Deductions Worksheet list for married filing jointly versus single?
queries._anchor_phrase: $32,200 if you’re married filing jointly or a qualifying surviving spouse
queries._expected_answer: $32,200 if married filing jointly (or qualifying surviving spouse); $16,100 if single or married filing separately

queries.question: On the 2026 Form W-4 Deductions Worksheet line 1c, your total income must be less than what amount (single) for qualified passenger vehicle loan interest, and up to what amount can you enter?
queries._anchor_phrase: your qualified passenger vehicle loan interest up to $10,000
queries._expected_answer: Total income less than $100,000 ($200,000 if married filing jointly); up to $10,000

queries.question: On the 2026 Form W-4, what is the exact percentage rate at which you can multiply your overtime work hours to qualify for the new overtime bonus tax credit?
queries._expected_answer: Absent. The form discusses qualified overtime compensation deductions with dollar caps ($12,500 / $25,000 MFJ on line 1b) but states NO percentage multiplier and no 'overtime bonus tax credit' — confirmed absent in both fw4 and the sibling f1040.

queries.question: What is the IRS phone number listed on the 2026 Form W-4 for calling the IRS withholding helpline?
queries._expected_answer: Absent. The form lists only the SSA number (800-772-1213) for name-mismatch questions and gives no IRS withholding helpline phone number — confirmed absent in both fw4 (only 800-772-1213 present) and the sibling f1040 (no phone number).

queries.question: What is the penalty dollar amount the 2026 Form W-4 says you will owe if you under-withhold your federal income tax?
queries._expected_answer: Absent. The form notes you 'may owe a penalty' if too little is withheld but states NO specific penalty dollar amount — confirmed absent in both fw4 and the sibling f1040 (f1040 line 38 only labels an 'Estimated tax penalty' line, no amount).
